result: I would remove the barrier between minds. Not the ability to speak or send signals, but the capacity to know what another feels as deeply as oneself. When the distance required to dehumanize another person disappears, and their pain cannot be hidden from your perception, the fundamental architecture of conflict shifts entirely.
